pages.text: When two genetic frogs breed, their offspring genome is stored in the frogspawn. That frogspawn hatches into $(l:zen_amphibia:lifecycle/tadpoles)tadpoles$(/l) carrying mixed parent $(l:zen_amphibia:genetics/dna_basics)DNA$(/l).
Genetic frogspawn hatches smaller clutches than vanilla frogspawn. This keeps breeding meaningful and helps ponds avoid $(l:zen_amphibia:lifecycle/overcrowding)overcrowded water$(/l).
